scripts.android:sync: npm run build && cap sync android
scripts.android:apk: VITE_ADMIN=1 npm run android:sync && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
scripts.android:bundle: npm run android:sync && cd android && ./gradlew bundleRelease
scripts.icons: npm run build:pages && (vite preview --port 4173 --strictPort > /dev/null & sleep 3; node scripts/export-icons.cjs; pkill -f 'vite preview')
